source_text: Omnis sacerdos inter homines parvus ad illum: Tu es sacerdos in aeternum secundum ordinem Melchisedech. Magnus sacerdos Christus.
pass_a_gloss: Every priest among humans small toward that: You are priest forever according-to order of-Melchizedek. Great priest Christ.
pass_b_english: Every human priest is small beside [[You are a priest forever after Melchizedek’s order >> Bible:Psalm 110:4]]. The great priest is Christ.
